newsitem.title: UK: Broker Iceni to close Hamburg office at end year.
newsitem.headline: Broker Iceni to close Hamburg office at end year.

text.p: Iceni Commodities Brokerage in Hamburg is closing at the end of the year, managing director Wolfgang Becker said on Monday.
Only the Hamburg office, not any other Iceni companies, will be affected by the decision, Becker said in a statement faxed to London.
He said he was closing the office because the metals markets are based on trust, but that has deteriorated.

"The developments over the last few years have proven that morality in our business has obviously deteriorated and that it has meanwhile become more appropriate to be overly cautious and always to expect the worst of everything and everybody," Becker said.
"This is no longer a pleasant environment to work in and I have therefore decided to get out of the brokerage business completely," he added.
Becker, who works with Peter Burnett and Jutta Beyer, said he had no immediate plans but expected he would remain connected with the metals world in some way.
Becker previously worked for Merrill Lynch in Hamburg and before that he was with Metallgesellschaft.
